changes: Centralized each climate zone's color, separator, and tint as inherited CSS tokens; zone panels, prediction buttons, and evidence chips retain their original computed colors.
Centralized the 16 subtype chip fills behind one --chip hook, removing repeated background declarations without changing any displayed color.
Declared subtype order once under its parent zone and derived the four zone names from that map, eliminating repeated classification prefixes while preserving all 16 groups and their order.
Renamed opaque top-level D/G/Z bindings to cities/subtypes/zones and expanded the analogue, board construction, layout, and FLIP geometry paths around semantic variables.
Added small find/make helpers, removed the unused zones Map, and removed an unnecessary full board layout on PREDICT; canonical state and all rendered evidence remain unchanged.

Removed the display:none question-mark node; the same full subtype remains available through each classification's title and focusable label, so pixels, input paths, and accessible classification text are preserved.

Second pass replaced 113-line compressed source with readable-compact modules for the state transition, live analogue rule, derived board records, FLIP geometry, SVG route, UI states, inputs, and lifecycle.
Split composite HTML templates with joined fragments, keeping generated DOM byte-equivalent on normal states without 548-805 character source lines.

Owned delegated handlers and keyboard focus RAF through one AbortController and unified teardown; pagehide now cancels focus, route, FLIP frames, timers, animations, resize ownership, and cached handlers.
Added a truthful dependency fallback that retains the 70-city matching rule when either the data or shared chassis cannot load.

cross_audit.scope: Second-pass readable-compact audit under build-interaction/references/general.md; formal archive remained read-only.

readable_compact.tradeoff: The formal source was compact/minified (76 JS lines, longest 805; 52 CSS lines, longest 326). The increase is retained because it exposes the real state, algorithm, derived layout, three UI states, FLIP/route motion, fallback, and ownership boundaries without minification or opaque bindings. Values, marks, content, and behavior were not removed to chase a smaller count.

evidence.pixel: 10/10 formal-candidate screenshot pairs at 1600x900 and 1280x720 are byte-identical/AE0 across initial, prediction, revealed, boundary id 69, and reset.
evidence.model: All 70 records independently recomputed with same-subtype filter and gap/id/name sort; every live analogue id matched, with one attempt and reset per record.
evidence.motion: Synchronous FLIP inversion maps are exactly equal; normal 2s transition, route and ghost, 700ms subsequent selection, rapid selection, and reset interruption pass. Active route coordinates differ by less than 0.001 logical px due to sampling time.
evidence.inputs: Mouse, keyboard Enter/Space with focus handoff, real touch tap, Celsius/Fahrenheit evidence, and reset pass.
evidence.responsive: 1600x900 to 1280x720 keeps route logical coordinates within 0.02 px and introduces no viewport overflow.
evidence.fallback: Aborting cities.js or base.js produces a visible rule-preserving fallback; controls disable rather than implying a working model.
evidence.lifecycle: pagehide cancels all owned work and handlers, cached nodes are inert, and reload produces one clean 70-city board.
evidence.runtime: Normal formal and candidate paths each produced zero console errors, page errors, and request failures.

rejected_high_risk_reductions: Do not compact, truncate, or replace cities.js: it is the locked real 70-record evidence layer and is excluded from author-layer chars.
Do not replace the analogue filter/sort with a precomputed lookup: that would hide the causal algorithm the sample is meant to teach.
Do not collapse the canonical transition function into event-local mutations or remove attempts: that would weaken the state/evidence contract.
Do not remove the origin ghost, dashed route, analogue marker, displaced-city FLIP, feedback states, unit path, or explanatory evidence to chase a lower count.
Do not shorten names into opaque bindings, minify HTML/CSS/JS, or serialize the page into generated markup; those options reduce Agent learnability.
Do not substitute static media for the live DOM grouping, prediction controls, real data rule, or responsive route geometry.
